wallets.purpose: The app's OWN Solana rail — the address every in-app SOL/USDC/EURC action signs from and every CeFi shift settles at (derived from the IC float seed, so ONE backup recovers both rails); all SOL-rail movements record under THIS id, never icp-float
Independent raw-seed SOL key created before the app's derived rail (sol-rail) was known — unused, no app code can sign from it; kept measured so it can never silently hold value

wallets.purpose: Dust EVM wallet — the OP2 gas-funder live proof: native-ETH gas destination for cross-rail converts (CCTP burns user-side to Ethereum; USDC lands at this address). Keyed by a fresh secp256k1 keypair; EIP-55 address committed plaintext in secrets/agent-evm.pub.json

Pre-rotation principal, compromised 2026-09-05 (partial key disclosure into a local tool log) and emptied by the same-day rotation; seed DESTROYED — a misdirected send here is unrecoverable. `just funds` watches it; `funds reconcile` anchors it at measured 0
